lines_of_business: All lines of business unless noted in Program Exceptions
Medicare Advantage: LCD Cervical Fusion L39799 reviewed
sections_in_order: Description (with Summary and Analysis of Evidence)
criteria_location: Position Statement only (about pp.3-5): four sub-policies, each its own bullet block: Cervical Spinal Fusion; Cervical Discectomy (with or without fusion); Cervical Laminectomy (with or without fusion); Cervical Disc Arthroplasty (plus two-level and subsequent-level). Description holds no criteria.
procedures_covered: Cervical fusion (ACDF, PCDF, single or multiple levels)
Cervical disc arthroplasty: single level, simultaneous 2nd level, subsequent adjacent level

logic.top_level: pathways: four procedure sections, each with its own criteria. Fusion is itself pathways (deformity OR instability OR radiculopathy/myelopathy-with-pain-and-imaging OR axial neck pain)

k_of_n.quote: Pain that is unresponsive to at least 6 weeks of conservative nonsurgical therapy that included at least 2 of the following: activity modification, exercise, analgesics, or physical therapy

logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Arthroplasty only: an inline bulleted contraindication list under 'Candidate is free from contraindications' (prior surgery at level, prior fusion at another level, translational instability, deformity, RA/autoimmune, facet arthritis, infection, metabolic bone disease, malignancy). Plus an 'experimental/investigational for all other indications' list (more than 2 levels, disc + fusion). Fusion/discectomy/laminectomy have no exclusion list. A smoking/nicotine criterion appears in the update history (07/15/19) but not in the current Position Statement.
logic.initial_vs_repeat: Arthroplasty has 'Subsequent cervical disc arthroplasty at an adjacent level ... when criteria above are met, AND device FDA-approved for 2 level, AND different cervical level, AND documentation ... initial ... is fully healed'. Codes for removal/revision (22861, 22864, 0095T, 0098T) are listed but no criteria are given for them. No repeat-fusion rules.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Cervical radiculopathy or myelopathy that included at least 1 of the following: ... Bowel and bladder incontinence, AND Pain that is unresponsive to at least 6 weeks ... AND Failure of epidural steroid injections ... AND Imaging studies demonstrate ... OR Treatment of axial neck pain when ...
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: A flat bullet list mixes 'OR' at the end of the deformity and instability bullets with trailing 'AND's on the radiculopathy sub-bullets. The visual nesting does not make clear whether pain failure, injection failure and imaging are required for deformity/instability too, or only for the radiculopathy pathway. Intended reading is probably: (deformity) OR (instability) OR (radiculopathy/myelopathy AND pain AND injections AND imaging) OR (axial neck pain pathway).

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Rapidly progressing neurologic deficits, OR Persistent debilitating neck, back, or arm pain [...] refractory to ... AND ... AND ... OR Symptoms of radiculopathy or myelopathy are refractory to ...
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Discectomy: nested AND lists inside an OR list inside an AND list; the trailing ', AND' on the last bullet of each inner list is easy to misattach.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Failure of epidural steroid injections or facet joint injections (if appropriate and not contraindicated)
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'if appropriate' is a judgment hidden in a requirement; who decides appropriate?

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Physical therapy, or documentation of inability to perform physical therapy
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Arthroplasty conservative-therapy bullet is a list of three with 'AND' but the last item lacks a trailing AND/OR, and 'unless contraindicated or not tolerated' is attached only to the pharmacotherapy item.

extraction_hazards: Bullet glyphs (bullet, o, black square) encode nesting depth; pdftotext keeps them but trailing ', AND' / ', OR' on last bullets is the only logic marker
Long Description with evidence summary precedes criteria; ~25 references and an 80-row-style CPT table follow
Header navigation table (Position Statement | Billing/Coding ...) repeated at top
The update history mentions criteria that no longer exist (nicotine cessation, 'and/or clonus', home exercise program) and could be mistaken for current criteria
Bracketed definition '[defined as daily pain with a VAS ...]' is inline inside a criterion
Page breaks fall inside bullet lists
interesting_structures: Same 6-week conservative-therapy block restated verbatim in three sub-policies
Axial neck pain pathway has a 6-month (not 6-week) trial and a 1-2 level cap
Rapidly progressing neurologic deficit is an OR that bypasses conservative therapy in discectomy/laminectomy
Arthroplasty contraindications are a NOT-list; healing documentation for sequential 2-level

fit_to_tree.scale: 1 = all/any/not expresses it cleanly ... 5 = needs new constructs or human judgment
fit_to_tree.why: Mostly all/any/not, with one k-of-n (2 of 4 conservative modalities). The fusion block's mixed AND/OR bullets need a human to fix the intended grouping. Many leaves are vague ('appropriate', 'if any', 'several weeks').
